QuestInfo.name: The Wanderer's Identity
QuestInfo.0: The watch transported you to Tera Forest, and that manmay be the only one that can explain how.
QuestInfo.1: #p2082004# said that he's a time traveler from the future. That sound insane...but stranger things have happened. Might as well hear him out.
QuestInfo.2: If what #p2082004# said is true, you've gotta do something. Listen to learn how to prevent the disaster.

0.0: Let me introduce myself first. I am #b#p2082004##k. Please understand that everything I'm about to tell you is the absolute truth, so try not to be too surprised.\r\n#L0##bI have no idea what you're talking about, but after all the crazy things I've seen, you'd have to try REALLY hard to surprise me.#l\n#k
0.1: I see. Well then... I am #rfrom the future#k. \r\n#L0##b...Wait, what?#l\n#k
0.2: Huh. Surprising you was actually pretty easy. Anyway, something terrible has happened, and I'm sure you'll want to help me sort things out. Are you ready to hear the story?

yes.0: I knew you would be interested, but you're still going to need some time to gather your thoughts. I also need some time to think.

no.0: I understand hearing something like this out of the blue might be too much. Come back when you're ready.

1.0: It seems like you're ready. Okay, so as I mentioned earlier, I'm from the future. To be more precise, I'm from #ran alternate future#k.\r\n#L0##bAn alternate future?#l\n#k
1.1: Yes. I shouldn't even be here, actually. I was aiming for Neo City in the year 1900. However, something went wrong...\r\n#L0##b'Something'? How bad is 'something'?#l\n#k
1.2: Very bad. My time travelling device broke, and sent me to many different time periods, until finally leaving me here.\r\n#L0##bThat doesn't seem like a huge deal...#l\n#k
1.3: Unfortunately, time is very sensitive. By travelling to other time periods, I've permanently changed the future in ways I cannot control. I...may have made things far worse than they already were.\r\n#L0##bThen...you telling me this stuff is also a problem, right?#l\n#k
1.4: Yes, but in the grand scheme of things, it hardly matters. You've already travelled through time, so our impact on each other is lessened.

yes.0: That is why I have a favor to ask of you. Come find me when you're ready to listen.
